_comment: DEMO RULES ONLY. Not a clinical protocol. Replace with a clinician-approved protocol (e.g. WHO ETAT danger signs) before any real use. Every text must stay in the GSM-7 alphabet (plain ASCII is safe).
name: Demo valley SMS triage (fictional)

complaints.label: Fever
complaints.advice: Fever: rest, drink plenty of clean water, take paracetamol as the pack says, cool the skin with a damp cloth. See a clinic if not better in 2 days.

complaints.label: Diarrhoea or vomiting
complaints.advice: Diarrhoea/vomiting: drink ORS (1L clean water, 6 level tsp sugar, half tsp salt) in small sips often. Keep eating. See a clinic if not better in 2 days.

complaints.label: Cough
complaints.advice: Cough: rest, drink warm fluids, keep away from smoke. See a clinic if it lasts more than 3 days or comes with fever.

text.area_menu: Nexus Care triage (DEMO). Reply with your area:
text.danger_menu: Any of these NOW? Reply a number:
text.red: CODE {code}. Go NOW to {clinic}. Show this code at the desk for fast care. Valid {hours}h.
text.yellow: CODE {code}. Go to {clinic} today and show this code at the desk. Valid {hours}h.
text.safety: Go NOW if: hard breathing, heavy bleeding, fits or chest pain.
text.repeat_code: Your code is still {code} for {clinic}. Text RESET to start again.
text.stopped: Stopped. Text HI any time to start again.
